title: The Too Much
description: Being a modern single woman can be tough when you have bad luck in romance.
quote: I am a simple time cop who has come from the year 2145 and I rode a time machine here.
altHero: Korean woman looking up longingly at a man in an elevator
alt1: woman is dejected as her boss drops a stack of papers on her desk
alt2: woman waves at the man from the elevator who is outside cleaning the window
alt3: the man opens a jewelry box to reveal a glowing jade hairpin
alt4: the woman is leaning on the man’s chest and her eyes are wide with surprise
